title: Measures to Handle Accidents where Passengers Fall onto MRT or LRT Tracks
what_it_is: Measures to Handle Accidents where Passengers Fall onto MRT or LRT Tracks

sections.label: Rail platform safety measures
sections.summary: Screen doors, LRT safety barriers, emergency stop plungers, safety announcements and video analytics trials are being used to prevent passengers falling onto tracks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To prevent passengers from falling onto the tracks, we have installed screen doors on every Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) platform.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are also installing safety barriers on all Light Rail Transit (LRT) platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Works for the Bukit Panjang LRT have been completed, and that for the Sengkang-Punggol LRT will be completed next year.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Fellow commuters can raise the alarm by pushing the brightly coloured emergency stop plungers located at every platform to stop the trains from entering or leaving the platform.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: When alerted, rail operators will immediately shut off traction power to the trains and dispatch trained personnel to the scene to provide assistance and first aid until the Singapore Civil Defence Force arrives.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Currently, rail operators are required to inform commuters about safety practices through prominent signs and regular announcements at train stations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA and the Singapore Mass Rapid Transit are also jointly trialling the use of video analytics to alert train operators to incidents on the tracks.
